scope: Private per-control continuation closure-proof cache; host model measurements only. No post-change restored frontend/file-load timing.

modes.uncached: Full one-argument readiness validator on every call.
modes.hit: Same functions, registry, roots and graph mode after a proof is installed.
modes.forced_miss: Remove private stamp before every call, then validate and test cache eligibility.

limits: Actual continuation hit rate and end-to-end benefit remain unmeasured.
Forced misses increase allocation by approximately 42% and have a higher wall-time median; this is not an unconditional speedup.
All modes still perform source/anchor/session/binding checks; graph hits also validate the live issued graph profile.
Finish and native-base validation remain uncached.

A separate pre-change ordinary-file trace attributed about 87 seconds / 127 GB allocation to closure validation within a 537-second load. This optimization concerns that component; it is not a measured post-change file-load improvement.

validation.execution: Existing warm host REPL only; regressions use their established tiny sources and modeled transports. No restored frontend bootstrap or full Init campaign.
